name: Design Qualified Lead Magnet
summary: Design an optional resource that delivers standalone value and signals genuine customer fit.
description: Design a guide, template, benchmark, checklist, diagnostic, or resource that creates standalone value and attracts qualified demand. Use when a team needs a lead magnet aligned with a real audience job and a consent-aware follow-up path.
refuses: It does not disguise an advertisement as neutral research or fabricate benchmark data.
It does not require unnecessary personal data or preselect promotional consent.
It does not withhold the promised core behind a sales call or surprise paywall.
